This is not a standard AI role.

At Kogan.com, you will sit at the centre of how we rethink the business through AI. Working directly with the CEO and CTO, you will lead high-impact initiatives while embedding intelligent automation across every function.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just experiment with AI, but builds real systems that scale. Someone who understands how to turn cutting-edge tools into a measurable competitive advantage.

If you are already operating at the frontier of autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, and AI-driven software development, this role gives you the mandate and backing to go further.

Partnering with departments across Kogan.com to build AI solutions that make their work faster and get things shipped quickly.
Working one-on-one with the CEO/CTO on high-impact, special projects to give us an unfair competitive advantage.
Rapidly prototyping and deploying production-ready software using AI-assisted "vibe coding."
Architecting and deploying autonomous agents (OpenClaw, OpenHands, LangGraph) to automate complex workflows in supply chain, marketing, and customer service.
Designing Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows to ensure AI bots have appropriate guardrails and approval gates before executing high-stakes production tasks.
Connecting AI agents securely to our e-commerce stack, ERPs, CRM, and internal databases.
You move fast and get things done. You don't wait for permission, you find the fastest path to a working solution and take it.
Strong foundation in computer science, systems architecture, and API integrations.
Proven experience with the absolute latest AI automation tools, multi-agent frameworks, and advanced workflow builders (n8n, Make.com).
Deep understanding of AI security protocols, containerization (Docker), and permission allowlists to protect enterprise data from prompt injections and rogue agent behavior.
Strong commercial awareness of LLM API costs to prevent resource drain and optimize token usage.
A relentless passion for AI and a habit of staying three steps ahead of industry trends.
Apply now and help us build the future of retail.

You will have direct access to executive decision-making, real scale, and the freedom to build.
This is an opportunity to define how AI is actually used inside one of Australia’s leading digital retailers, not just experiment on the sidelines.
Our culture is unlike anywhere else and regardless of where you are in your career journey, we empower you to do your best work and have a big impact. Check out https://devblog.kogan.com/ and https://goodteams.app/engineering/kogan.com.
Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand’s eCommerce future.
Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape. You’ll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact.
You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia.
Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ.
A range of employee benefits such as; Meaningful Learning budget. Complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Companyand team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!
AI-enabled. Human-driven. Shipping smarter every day.

Kogan.com is a pioneer of Australian eCommerce, and the software we build is used by millions of customers every day. You'll join a fast-moving engineering team with real ownership, shipping to production daily and using AI as part of how we work.

# David Cropper

Melbourne, VIC · https://www.linkedin.com/in/david-cropper/ · https://journey.chaseriskandcompliance.com.au/ · https://github.com/dcrops

**Senior AI Engineer**

---

## Professional Summary

AI Engineer with strengths in Docker, Operational intelligence, Python, and FastAPI. Background: Commercial technology experience since 2009 spanning software quality assurance, test automation, and Data Engineering, including 3.5 years of commercial enterprise Data Engineering experience, plus independent AI Engineering and portfolio development producing production-oriented AI systems spanning retrieval-augmented generation, operational intelligence, explainable AI, and enterprise decision support. Builds applications with Python, FastAPI, Docker, OpenAI APIs, and a transferable AI Engineering methodology centred on architecture-first design, roadmap-driven delivery, evidence-based validation, and human-in-the-loop review. Interested in engineering AI systems that deliver measurable operational outcomes.

## Selected Engineering Highlights

- Engineering stack includes **Python**, **FastAPI**, **Docker**, **OpenAI APIs**, LangChain, and vector databases where project evidence supports them.
- Designed and built multiple production-minded AI applications spanning RAG, **operational intelligence**, explainable diagnostics, and career decision support.
- Applies a transferable AI Engineering methodology: product vision, technical design documents, architecture-first design, milestone delivery, golden validation suites, and GO / NO-GO release decisions.
- Focuses on transparent, evidence-backed recommendations and explainable AI decision support rather than opaque model outputs.
- Maintains a public portfolio demonstrating architecture, testing, and engineering decision-making.

## Core Skills

**Docker** · **Python** · **FastAPI** · **OpenAI APIs**

**Also:** PyTest · Git · SQL · AWS · S3 · Athena · Glue · Cloudwatch

## Professional Experience

### AI Engineer - Independent Research & Development — Chase Risk & Compliance

*Dec 2025 – Present · Independent engineering · Melbourne, VIC*

- Implements systems with **Python**, **FastAPI**, **Docker**, **OpenAI APIs**, Git, and PyTest, documenting architecture and testing decisions in a public portfolio.
- Independently designs and builds production-minded AI Engineering systems under a dedicated portfolio brand, spanning retrieval-augmented generation, **operational intelligence**, explainable AI, and enterprise decision support.
- Applies a transferable AI Engineering methodology: product vision and technical design documents, architecture-first design, roadmap and milestone-driven delivery, living documentation, and documentation freeze before release.
- Uses repository-wide AI context, structured architecture reviews, controlled AI-assisted implementation boundaries, and human-in-the-loop validation including golden validation suites and GO / NO-GO release decisions.

**Technologies:** **Python**, **FastAPI**, **Docker**, **OpenAI APIs**, Git, PyTest

### AI Engineering Professional Development and Portfolio Development — Independent study

*Jul 2025 – Nov 2025 · Professional development · Melbourne, VIC*

- Made a deliberate pivot from Data Engineering to AI Engineering as the primary career focus.
- Undertook structured AI Engineering study.
- Adopted increasingly production-oriented engineering practices, including testing, documentation, and milestone-driven development.

**Technologies:** **Python**, **OpenAI APIs**, LangChain, Git, PyTest

### Data Engineering Professional Development and Career Transition — Independent study

*Oct 2023 – Jun 2025 · Professional development · Melbourne, VIC*

- Undertook structured upskilling in modern Data Engineering.
- Prepared for a return to Data Engineering work.

**Technologies:** Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Azure Data Factory

### Data Engineer — nbn Australia

*Mar 2020 – Oct 2023*

- Developed and maintained enterprise data pipelines and operational reporting solutions using AWS services, **Python**, SQL, and Apache NiFi.
- Performed SQL transformations, data validation, and production support for geospatial and business-operational datasets.

**Technologies:** **Python**, SQL, AWS, S3, Athena, Glue, Cloudwatch, DynamoDB, Apache NiFi, Git, PyTest

## Featured AI Projects

### Governance-Aware Document Intelligence RAG

**Purpose:** Enterprise retrieval-augmented generation platform supporting trustworthy AI responses over organisational knowledge.

**Engineering Highlights:**

- Multi-format document ingestion
- Embedding generation
- Retrieval orchestration

**Outcomes:**

- Supports grounded responses over multi-format organisational documents.

**Technology Stack:** **Python** · **FastAPI** · **Docker** · LangChain · ChromaDB · OpenAI · PyTest · Git

### Operational Intelligence Copilot

**Purpose:** Domain-agnostic operational intelligence platform combining deterministic analytics with Large Language Model reasoning to analyse structured business data and generate explainable, evidence-backed executive insights.

**Engineering Highlights:**

- Explainable AI recommendations
- Intelligent intent routing
- Dataset profiling

**Outcomes:**

- Produces evidence-backed executive reporting.

**Technology Stack:** **Python** · **FastAPI** · **OpenAI APIs** · PyTest · Git

### Payroll Diagnostics Engine

**Purpose:** Rule-based operational decision-support platform that identifies payroll anomalies through deterministic business-rule evaluation.

**Engineering Highlights:**

- Operational analytics
- Rule engines
- Explainable diagnostics

**Outcomes:**

- Produces explainable operational findings.

**Technology Stack:** **Python** · Pandas · OpenPyXL · PyTest · Git

### Career Intelligence Copilot

**Purpose:** Decision-support system for AI Engineering job search: career profile, job analysis, opportunity assessment, portfolio matching, application strategy, opportunity tracking, and evidence-grounded CV generation with human review gates.

**Engineering Highlights:**

- Product vision and functional specification
- Architecture-first design and ADRs
- Roadmap-driven milestone delivery

**Outcomes:**

- Delivers an explainable job-intelligence loop from profile through strategy and tailored CV drafts under owner review.
- Uses golden validation suites and formal GO / NO-GO close-out for release-quality engineering decisions.

**Technology Stack:** **Python** · Pydantic · **OpenAI APIs** · PyTest · Git

## AI Engineering Methodology

Applies AI to improve engineering quality and delivery discipline, not to replace engineering judgement.

**Planning:** Product vision · Technical design documents · Architecture-first design · Roadmap-driven delivery · Milestone planning · Acceptance criteria

**Implementation:** Repository-wide AI context · Controlled AI-assisted implementation boundaries · Iterative feature development · Architecture-aligned coding standards

**Quality:** PyTest regression testing · Behavioural testing · Evidence-based debugging · Golden validation suites

**Review:** Structured architecture reviews · Maintainability review · Human-in-the-loop validation · Refactoring with preserved behaviour

**Delivery:** Git version control · Small reviewable commits · Living documentation · Documentation freeze · Phase close-outs · Release validation · GO / NO-GO release decisions

## Certifications

- **AWS Certified Developer - Associate** — Amazon Web Services
- **Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional** — Databricks
